old_problem: Items, the literal selector and DeepSeek all identify standard SMBIOS Type 37 Memory Channel, while one parenthetical phrase names Type 36 Management Device Threshold Data. The prior review left that copy-label conflict for engineering. Direct inspection shows the immediately preceding row 1557 independently and coherently owns Type 36 with its own code, command, six thresholds and association contract. Treating the parenthetical as another Type 36 branch here would duplicate—not preserve—its separate coverage.
disposition_reason: The combination of DMTF structure identity and adjacent-source provenance is sufficient to correct only the Review layer: this row is Type 37 Memory Channel. Its title, numeric type, literal command, parser heading, code and required topology all agree; row 1557 separately preserves Type 36. The executable test captures every complete Type 37 structure, uses Memory Device Count—not output line count—to parse each Load/Handle pair, resolves every handle to Type 17 in the same SMBIOS table, compares channel type/membership/load with the Project topology and enforces total device load not exceeding Maximum Channel Load. Expected matrices and target applicability are Project configuration. No Type 36 threshold coverage is borrowed, duplicated or removed.
decision_basis: The exact XLSX rows 1557 and 1558 were both read through the repository extractor with matching row hashes, along with q96 same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, historical V3.1 record, generic script identity, duplicate search and locked queue. The next formal identity is row 1575 / variant bd89b1d42d35d7bc.
DMTF SMBIOS DSP0134 v3.9.0 section 7.38 defines Type 37 as Memory Channel and Type 36 as Management Device Threshold Data. These have different layouts and acceptance oracles.

Row 1557 immediately preceding this source consistently names Type 36 in Items, command, parenthetical and DeepSeek, and its historical review independently validates six thresholds plus Type 35/component context. The repeated parenthetical in row 1558 is therefore traceable copy residue, not an unowned requirement.

Type 37 correlates a memory channel with Type 17 Memory Device structures. Required fields are Channel Type, Maximum Channel Load, Memory Device Count and one Device Load/Device Handle pair per declared device.

The declared Memory Device Count determines pair count. Structure length must contain at least `7 + 3*n` bytes, but future schema growth may append data, so length is not used to infer n or reject documented extension bytes blindly.

Every Device Handle must resolve inside the same captured SMBIOS table to Type 17, without dangling, wrong-type or unintended duplicate membership. Type 17 Device Locator/Bank Locator/serial/size data may correlate the Project slot map but do not replace the Type 37 relationship.

The sum of all Device Load values for a channel cannot exceed Maximum Channel Load. Exact expected load values, membership, channel count and order-versus-set semantics come from the board/BIOS topology specification, not guessed from DIMM names.
SMBIOS Type 37 firmware metadata does not exercise training, bandwidth, interleave, ECC or RAS behavior. Those remain separate tests and cannot be inferred from a structurally correct channel table.
DeepSeek's heading grep is inadequate and hides count/pairs. Use complete stdout/stderr/status through authenticated access and preserve logs instead of executing the source's generic clear step.

test_case.test_name: SMBIOS Type 37 Memory Channel count, load and Type 17 handle validation
test_case.purpose: Verify every standard SMBIOS Type 37 Memory Channel record against the exact platform channel topology, including channel type, maximum load, declared device count, every device load and same-table Type 17 handle relationship, while leaving the adjacent Type 36 threshold testcase independent.
required_package: Exact SUT/board/CPU/memory population, BIOS build and SMBIOS version/entry-point/table identity; validated dmidecode and raw Type 37/17 parser versions
Owner-approved Type 37 oracle listing every expected channel/handle, Channel Type, Maximum Channel Load, Memory Device Count, per-device load, Type 17 handle membership and order-versus-set policy

Same-build Type 17 memory-device/slot map with handle, Device Locator, Bank Locator, serial/part/size/population identity for correlation; authoritative expected-absent/N/A and disabled/empty-channel policy
Secure authenticated least-privilege SMBIOS access and protected raw/parsed evidence; optional generic private-script content/hash/provenance and complete-coverage proof if used
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY TYPE 37/17 COLLECTION; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Bind Source Key/variant and capture target, board/CPU/population, BIOS and SMBIOS entry-point/table identities plus dmidecode/parser versions. Through protected access run `dmidecode --type 37` with no grep or stderr suppression and capture command/status/stdout/stderr/hash; capture the complete Type 17 structures from the same SMBIOS table/snapshot. For every Type 37 handle parse Channel Type, Maximum Channel Load and Memory Device Count n, then exactly n Device Load/Device Handle pairs; verify the formatted area contains at least `7 + 3*n` bytes while preserving documented trailing extension data. Resolve every handle to a Type 17 structure in that same table, map it to the approved slot/DIMM identity, enforce the owner membership/order/duplicate rules, calculate the load sum and require it not exceed Maximum Channel Load. Compare every channel and pair with the Project oracle, report missing/extra/dangling/wrong-type/malformed/load violations and authoritative expected absence. Do not run Type 36 as this row, change memory/BIOS/RAS/interleave state or clear logs. Use the private generic script only after inspected proof of complete Type 37/17 evidence.
test_case.expected_result: Every expected applicable Type 37 channel exists exactly as specified; Channel Type, Maximum Channel Load, declared count and every load/handle pair match the approved topology; each handle resolves to the correct populated or specified Type 17 device in the same table; required structural length is present; and each channel's total device load is within its maximum. No unexplained extra, missing, duplicate, dangling, wrong-type or malformed entry appears, and no memory, BIOS, log or hardware state changes.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact target/BIOS/SMBIOS/table identity, complete successful Type 37 plus same-snapshot Type 17 evidence, authoritative topology, exactly n pairs per declared count, valid minimum length, correct channel/load/membership values, all handles resolved to intended Type 17 records and sum(loads) <= maximum for every channel. FAIL covers a required channel with wrong/missing/extra/duplicate data, count/length inconsistency, dangling/wrong-type handle, incorrect slot membership, load overflow or malformed structure. NOT READY covers missing topology/tool/access/parser/script authority. N/A/expected absence requires explicit target firmware specification. Type 36 row-1557 output, heading-only grep, slot-name inference or memory functional tests cannot substitute.
safety_gate: Collection is strictly read-only. Do not alter DIMM population, channel/interleave/RAS/speed settings, BIOS, firmware, memory training or logs.
Use authenticated target access and least privilege; do not expose passwords, disable host validation, suppress errors or accept empty/truncated output.
Capture Type 37 and referenced Type 17 from one stable SMBIOS table identity. Stop if a firmware update/reboot/table change occurs between captures.
Do not relabel Type 37 as Management Device Threshold Data or duplicate row 1557 Type 36. Preserve the Master wording as history and the correction only in this Review layer.
Use Memory Device Count to parse pairs and validate minimum length; do not infer count from grep lines or reject future documented trailing fields without schema analysis.
Stop on malformed tables, wrong target, unresolved handles or unsafe access; preserve first evidence and do not automatically retry with a different filter/parser to obtain a preferred result.
The review agent executes no command/script/DUT action and issues no hardware PASS; metadata correctness is not memory functional qualification.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/variant; target/board/CPU/memory population/BIOS/SMBIOS/table/dmidecode/parser identities; explicit adjacent row-1557 Type 36 separation
Versioned Type 37 expected channel/load/count/Type 17 membership matrix and expected-absence/order/duplicate policy
Literal commands, exit status, stderr, complete raw Type 37 and same-snapshot Type 17 output/table hashes
Per-channel parsed fields, n pairs, minimum-length calculation, load sum versus maximum and same-table handle/type resolution
Type 17 locator/serial/part/size/population correlation, expected-versus-observed diff and malformed/dangling/duplicate diagnostics
No-clear/no-mutation audit, optional private-script inspection, Tool Result/engineer-verdict separation and no-DUT-action statement
test_case.recovery: The intended operation is read-only. If capture, parsing, table identity, length, handle resolution or topology is ambiguous, stop and preserve complete raw stdout/stderr/status/table hashes. Do not reseat DIMMs, change BIOS/memory settings, run Type 36 as substitute, clear logs or automatically recollect through a lossy filter. Resolve the Project matrix/parser or firmware-table defect offline; any new capture is a separately recorded attempt.

source_conflict.reason: DMTF semantics plus direct adjacent-row evidence prove the parenthetical is copied Type 36 text. The Review layer binds this row to its concordant title, number and command as Type 37, while row 1557 retains the complete independent Type 36 identity and coverage.

external_authorities.application: Section 7.38/Table 112 defines Type 37 Memory Channel, `7 + 3*n` minimum formatted length, Count-controlled Load/Handle pairs and the load-sum invariant; Type 36 remains the separate threshold structure.

project_authority: The BIOS/memory owner supplies the exact Type 37 channel/load/Type 17 topology and applicability; the engineer owns the final verdict. They cannot relabel this row as Type 36, merge row 1557 coverage, infer handles from slot names, accept a heading-only read, waive load/count/handle invariants or represent metadata as functional memory qualification.
